summary: This paper presents a definitive, machine-checked closure of the biology-grade E-track regarding non-equilibrium Gaussian squeezing and continuous-variable entanglement in 71 THz mitochondrial cristae polaritons. Through exact symplectic algebra, Pythagorean quadrature defect identities, and two-mode PPT factorizations, the author proves that sustaining steady-state entanglement at physiological temperature (310 K) requires maintenance power exceeding the mitochondrion's entire basal metabolic budget by nearly 1,000-fold, while unpumped states undergo rapid finite-time entanglement sudden death within ~9.6-9.9 ps.
